title: Murshid Quli Khan consolidates fiscal authority in Bengal
detail: As diwan, he tightened revenue administration and began to build an institutional base that reduced dependence on Dhaka's earlier administrative routines.

title: Administrative shift from Dhaka toward Makhsudabad
detail: The effective transfer of core administration toward Makhsudabad began, with court, officials, and major financial actors increasingly oriented to the new center.

title: Murshidabad fully established as Bengal's capital
detail: With Murshid Quli Khan's formal appointment as subahdar, Murshidabad's role as the province's political-fiscal capital was consolidated.

title: Pre-1757 Nawabi political economy is re-centered
detail: Murshidabad became the core arena for state finance, elite competition, and court politics that framed the later crisis of 1757.
